notes:
Img2Gen is a browser-based GPT Image 2 studio for creators, founders,
marketers, ecommerce teams, and product teams that need polished AI visuals
from prompts or reference images.

The product combines text-to-image generation, image-to-image edits, up to
five reference uploads per request, aspect ratio controls, low/medium/high
quality settings, generation history, downloads, daily free generations, and
paid credit workflows. It is designed as a focused creative workspace rather
than a heavy design dashboard.

Img2Gen supports practical visual jobs such as posters, portraits, product
listing images, campaign concepts, headshots, ecommerce scenes, social
creatives, landing page visuals, and reference-guided restyles. Public SEO
pages explain GPT Image 2 prompts, AI image generation, image-to-image AI,
product photo generation, poster generation, and headshot workflows.
